summary_en: 11,948,808 shares to be cancelled (8.69% of issued shares). Post-cancellation issued shares: 125,437,664. Treasury shares after cancellation: 560,000. Effective 2026-08-21.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-05, the board of directors of Nippon Denko Co., Ltd. resolved to cancel 11,948,808 treasury shares under the Companies Act Section 178. The shares represent 8.69% of issued shares prior to cancellation. The cancellation will take effect on 2026-08-21. Following the cancellation, issued shares outstanding will total 125,437,664, with 560,000 treasury shares remaining (figures as of 2026-06-30).
